text: The free version is terrible. Bro you can only do 6 skips per hour and then it gives you a whole bunch of recommendations into the playlists you're listening to! like bro when I make a playlist I like it how it is I don't need some robot to recommend things for it! like seriously! I pay for premium now, because it's worth it, but barely. The paid version is excellent but very expensive.

free version sucks. Windows media player is better by light years (and WMP isn't an amazing platform, either). premium version works well enough to play music from, but is very confusing in how song ratings work. audiobooks are severely limited (15 hours with premium, and 15 hours more on a separate subscription - per month). if you want audiobooks or free music, I highly recommend a different platform.

Edit 2/27/26: Something seems to have changed in the last few weeks. I listen a lot, probably 4-5 hours a day while I do renovation work and every time I open the app it shows a "you are back online" message and it takes 2-3 minutes to load up all the recommendations and personalization stuff. Most of the time I am connected to high quality Wi-Fi or 5G networks. it's definitely not a connection issue since it happens everywhere I go. It's a music app so it's not critical, but still.

Shuffle does not actually shuffle. 'Shuffle' is just Spotify's version of a playlist. If I add a song to the queue, it'll play the song but will not change the shuffle, so that song could be played right away again if it was in that order of the 'shuffle'. Super annoying, especially considering the monthly price keeps going up, but the issue doesn't get resolved! Also, my app keeps skipping! Makes me feel like I'm back in the 90's and I need to take the CD out and wipe it off! it's not my settin

there are multiple things wrong with it, though it does have a lot of music it's hard to get to that music you want because of how it's set up. When I try to get a song it plays a different song from "things we added" which is really just a way to get money so you get so annoyed that you pay for premium. It plays other songs before it plays your song and it only lets you skip five times, it also adds things to your own playlist when you try to create one. I won't be using this app anymore.

Great app! The only thing I hate about this app is that it literally does NOT give us the bare minimum!? For example, being able to loop a song. I get the ad part, I don't mind it that much actually– but why not give free users the loop button? We already deal with 6 skips an hour, 2-4 ads after 2 songs, and not being able to play a playlist in order. Plus, the individual premium is 12 dollars a month, probably not bad for others, but I wouldn't buy it for a music app. Updated: Not much changed.

This company has just the worst software. It is slow to load and not very responsive. I click to play a different song and it takes 5 seconds to switch songs, if it does it at all. Constantly disconnects from connected devices. I move a song in the playlist and it bounces around, sometimes returning back to original position. The AI DJ just plays the same songs over and over and the voice is obnoxious. Some of these bugs have been in the software for nearly 10 years and still not fixed.

I love having the music. I use spotify every day. Three stars because the app itself is absolute trash. It is constantly crashing, freezing, and randomly stopping. EDIT 03/22: don't know what they did but they made it worse than ever. Spotify is trash, yall. Edit 08/24: Dear Spotify. Pay artists more. Also do something about the various versions of songs as it relates to the favorites list. Maybe like suggest the other versions when you add the song to a playlist or something.

I had to edit my review, it used to be 5 stars but I'm lowering it because all of the sudden, every now and then, it'll switch what Im listening to. I've been listening to a podcast's library and it switched me to a curated list. If you want to make me a recommended list, fine but I don't HAVE to listen to that other stuff and this app is making it so I have to. Super inconvenient, especially while driving. I've used this app for years and never had any issues until recently.

App has become horribly unstable. The app crashes on me every other song, sometimes I get two songs in-between. I have reinstalled the app, cleared the cache, undownloaded and redownloaded all saved playlist. But the app still crashes constantly. Not worth the membership cost anymore, given that I can't enjoy my music. I hope it gets fixed with the next update, but considering the issue wasn't fixed after the last time I brought this issue up, I'm not hopeful.

When using the Free version of this app, searching and playing a song is broken. For example, if I search and play "Billie Jean" by MJ, it will play "Beat it" or "Thriller". Earlier versions of spotify did not do this and it makes this app one of the most unreliable apps for Free music playing - along with your procured playlists on permenant shuffle. You'd be better off with competitor products. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND - unless you have over 100 dollars a year to blow on premium.

I am so tired of this app. It gets more and more expensive. I had premium and it advertises audiobooks with your subscription, but only allows so many hours before it wants more money. cancelled premium bc I only listen to podcasts that have ads built in, forgot my alarm was set to my spotify Playlist. instead of a song, I woke up to 6 consecutive ads I had to listen to to get back to my podcast, to listen to more ads. Total garbage.

At this point, just make Spotify a paid app cause instead of two ads, it's three, sometimes even FOUR. says 30 mins without ads, but it's like 5 mins, adds random songs in my Playlist, can only skip 6 songs each hour, and can't see what song is up next. a little update!! I love listening to music!! but I got 5 ads in a row. And I am not paying for Spotify premium.

Great navigation, love the system and format, especially the playlist making system. It's just SO MANY ads, and that's not something I usually complain about but seriously? After every other song? The thirty minute ad breaks don't even work, it's totally immersion breaking, especially getting the same ads over and over and the singing ones are just so annoying. Quit money grabbing, not everyone has money to throw away. Sometimes it just skips songs on its own and it's janky on Aux.

Plays 1 song at a time. No longer able to listen to playlists or stations. It stops after 1 song. I've cleared cache. Restarted my phone. Uninstalled and reinstalled. Even cleared storage and Uninstalled other apps. Nothing works. I stopped my subscription due to similar issues and now this free version is no longer worth the work or time. I'm done.

I very much like this app and have loved organizing all my songs and playlists. I'm a musician, so I have dozens of playlists. Overall great app, but please bring back the hearts! I don't know why it ever needed to get changed, but I way much more prefered the heart symbol to like a song over the little plus sign. It's now much more complicated than it needed to be.

The apps performance really has degraded recently. Crashing every thirty or so minutes, randomly pausing songs, or just straight up dropping the playlist after it crashes and starts playing "trending" songs. I can't listen to custom mixes anymore because it crashes and kills the playlist so I have to restart it. The advertisement vs song ratio has become has become a joke, I can listen to FM radio stations and get less ads.

I absolutely love Spotify and have since 2008. I always pay for premium because I can't stand commercials. Reason for the 4 star rating is due to a reoccurring issue causing me to reinstall the app to fix it. Eventually i can only play 1 genre of music from my library. doesn't matter if I make a shuffle all playlist or select a specific song from different genre. it only affects my downloaded/liked songs. It could be 4 months or a year, it always seems to happen. It's very annoying.

I am not a fan of the results that kick out anytime I go to a song's "Go to song radio". When I want to go to the radio of a particular song, I expect similar songs that align with the song tempo/genre. However, this option just shuffles the latest music that has been released. I'm not sure if that's what is intended with this option, however my interpretation is that it should be playing similar music styles. If I wanted to listen to new releases, I would just go to my release radar.

Great streaming app. 2 things I wish they would add, one, a "dislike" button to compliment the heart. Hiding songs isn't the same. Makes playlists shorter by just not playing a song, and doesn't solve the problem of a not liked song showing up on playlists. It just gets grayed out and skipped. Let me dislike the song and just don't waste a spot on my Playlist with it. Secondly, the my DJ thing would be so much better if it didn't consistently cut off 30 seconds to a minute of most songs

I used to use spotify alot and I thought it was the best music app, but that was only because I was paying for premium, without premium you can't even skip or pick any of the music, you can only use shuffle or play it the playlist regularly but with my playlist I have a bunch of the same people over and over and that gets annoying, plus the app usually closes when I try to use it in the background then it gives me three 30 second ads after it just told me I get 30 minutes of uninterrupted music.

I've had Spotify premium for years. It's great to be able to select specific songs and listen without ads and they do have a really wide selection. I used to love their recs but the algorithms suck now. Harder to find new music bc they just keep pushing the same old. I also wish they would bring back the curated running playlist mix (your likes, mixed, w specific bpm).

I used to really like Spotify because it was extremely simple and had a large library. It hasn't changed too much, but the problem is that over the years this app has started to work less and less. In the modern day Spotify feels barely functional: Constantly crashing, extremely slow, skipping large portions of playlists, a broken shuffle feature, and buggy bluetooth drivers. I just need an app that plays music and actually works.

I've been loyal to Spotify for over a decade. But it is not the same platform it used to be. It is impossible to discover small artists. My recommendations are clogged with popular sponsored artists, even ones I've BLOCKED. All the cool features and staff curated playlists are soulless AI garbage now that Spotify has laid off hundreds of employees. Adding songs to a playlist (my favorite feature) frequently crashes my phone. Premium rates rise. If I find a good alternative, I will switch.

The shuffle doesn't really shuffle your music, it just plays the songs you've been listening to recently. The discover weekly sucks, its not at all tailored to my taste, it NEVER has the genres I listen to and ive only found a handfull of songs I actually like from it. The offline option is very iffy, sometimes it'll load but a lot of times it won't and tell me I'm offline. Well duh, thats why I'm in offline mode!! I like this app but would love it if things were improved.

App isn't great. Bad UI, glitchy additions of songs to playlists, discrepancies between data of the web client and mobile, and often recommends music I dislike in service to some unknowable algorithm. The ceo investing in the military industrial complex's use of ai makes me plan on dropping it entirely. Spotify's main draw is its collection, which I'm sure will migrate elsewhere at some point

One problem: I have a shared playlist with a friend. It's very long, over 8 hours. Recently, some songs will just disappear from the playlist without either my friend or I touching them. I'll see songs I've added to the playlist a while ago in the recommended songs at the bottom of the playlist. I'll add it back. Its happened one or twice where the same song will disappear after being added back. We both have premium if that makes a difference.

I don't have premium but I get alot of ads, I get 2-4 adds after one song. I get the same ads over and over. But it's still a great app for listening to music on, there's plenty of podcasts to listen to, you can even make your own playlists and add any song to it! Still an amazing app! I changed my mind a bit, recently I've been getting 5 ads after one song I've uninstalled and reinstalled the app and it's not helping I've been trying to listen to a certain song and can't due to skips.

I've been using this app for several years now (paying for ad-free, too), however it has become more of a hassle than anything recently. It plays a song or two, then pauses altogether rather than moving on to the next song in the queue. I contacted customer support for assistance, and all they could advise is that I uninstall and reinstall it, which works for a period of time before the error comes back. The only thing keeping me on Spotify has been my playlists, but that may not be enough now.

Free podcasts are cool, that's one of the only upsides though. Theres a new issue every month. The episodes are constantly glitching and restarting, after I've finished an episode,it will restart, and when a playlist I've downloaded ends, why would you try to play music I don't have downloaded? I just end up listening to nothing for the rest of my shift. The subscription is always going up while there are issues that just keep ruining the app for me. Not worth it at all.

Spotify is honestly one of those apps that just becomes part of your daily routine without you even noticing. It’s super easy to use, and it somehow always knows what you want to hear—like the playlists and recommendations feel really personal, not random. What I like most is that it doesn’t feel limited. You can switch from music to podcasts to something new you’ve never heard before, and it all just flows naturally. It’s simple, but it doesn’t feel basic.

I love Spotify until 06/20/26. I did an update, and now my app doesn't open!!! I use Spotify on a daily basis for work, and I will not pay for something that does not work!!!( Yes, uninstalled,reinstalled your app) that's just a temporary fix!!!! I've spent years building my music library and playlist. please fix this issue, I do not want to have to find a new music streaming service.😞 (Thank you for the quick response, the clean reinstall seems to have worked.)🙂

Better than Pandora, but getting popups for things I'm not interested in when I pay for premium... is getting old VERY quickly. I also don't care about audio books... I came here for music why hit me with a pop-up about books? The algorithm has really been missing the mark as well lately. Rarely playing new music, repeating the same songs, or when I finally find a playlist I like... it changes. Really if the popups continue I'll stop paying and just listen to my own music on another app.

Sort of works, 4/5 days it seems fine. Other days it wants to recommend the same 2 podcasts that I have no interest in and it won't let me remove them from recommended, or my taste profile (that I've searched for and can't find). The only thing I can do is leave a bad review to a podcast that is fine, just not for me. The rest of the day it does this play/pause thing that I have to remove the app just to play anything again, I've never shared my login. Has the music my kid wants to listen to.

I've been a Spotify premium member for years and honestly thinking about just canceling my subscription. The shuffle plays the same songs in the same order over and over. I've tried going into settings to fix it and it just won't stop. My playlist has almost 1.5k songs on it, there's absolutely no reason it should be playing the same stuff over and over again. Do better for charging people $15/month and not properly paying the artists that make the music.

What's up with the songs that suddenly sound different? Add song to a playlist and after a couple weeks the song I've listened to a dozen times is suddenly a completely different sound. Same or similar lyrics, same melody, but a different tempo and composition, and suddenly the voice has a weird Transylvanian (?) accent? What is this? Please fix.

Overall I like the app now that I am on premium. If the price raises any more I'll go back to radio though. They have most of the songs I like, but there is a growing library of of music I cannot listen to anymore. The new widget is also very limited. the old widget would allow me to activate an auto-generated Playlist then mark the songs I liked. the new widget still plays the Playlist but I have to open the app to mark the songs I like.

too many ads, but there are a lot of songs to choose from, and you can have thousands of songs on one playlist. I do wish that when you create a new account, you can try 1-3 weeks of premium without it going to the purchase area, but other than that, it is a really good app with tons of different music styles, genres, types, artists, etc.

money hungry. constant ads after 2-3 songs. if I'm lucky then 4-5. half of those ads are to advertise Spotify premium, how desperate are you? when I'm using the app on my tv I get 5 ads at once. I would like to use another music app but this one has so many songs and playlists, it would be terrible to create those playlists and like songs all over again. I like how you can get 30 minutes without ads. and I'm glad that not everything is restricted for free users. but still that's the bare minimum

problem 1 after every single song 3 to 6 ads play and they are 30 to 60 seconds long and you can't skip them in app I understand that they have to make money somehow but with how many people buy premium I feel 6 30 second ads is just greedy. problem 2 a lot of features are locked or hard to access I know why this is it's to encourage people to buy premium but having a random song that is "similar to your Playlist" is not even close to what I want to listen to. otherwise a decent app for music.

Used to be great. Something changed at some point. I'm paying for premium, have 3000+ songs saved, and their shuffle algorithm absolutely sucks. Plays the same few hundred songs(being generous) and in the same order. It's really not shuffle. Reached out a few times about it and got nowhere. I'm probably canceling soon.

I'll be blunt. the new music widget absolutely sucks. the old one worked great. but this "new and improved" one... won't even open 80% of the time and when it does it opens to the complete wrong song or playlist that you were playing. it's quite disappointing. I used to use the widget daily. now I almost never use it. in fact it has decreased my Spotify usage.... better luck next time spotify

Spotify is a great app for listening to music. If you have a group of friends or family that all want premium, it is very affordable to split costs and definitely worth it. there is a plethora of songs and podcasts to keep you entertained, and it has some cool features like creating a playlist based off of a prompt you gave, or a cool blend option to make a playlist with your friends to mix your tastes into 1 playlist and see how similar your tastes are. Awesome app!

got rid of the 1x3 widget for no reason. I don't want to use half my screen for the 2x high widget. Honestly makes the whole experience so much worse. Edit: despite Spotify's response it still sucks. can't go forward or back. It still gets stuck on can't update, and changes to some random playlist when I reach the end of my podcasts. It has made my Spotify experience so much worse.

the only good thing about this app is the premium with no ads, unlimited skips and repeats, and doing wtv you want with your playlists every time I want to play a game, my music stops and Spotify decides to restart my entire song, it's just repetitive and I thought it was a 1 time thing, but it's an every day thing, it happens 2-3 times a day if I'm lucky Edit: it's happening at least 6 times a day now and 4 if I'm lucky, which I never am, pls fix your app

5 minutes of songs with 2 minutes of ads. can only listen to so many books with a subscription. I'll get the subscription again, if you can do a little better. otherwise I can just be a pirate instead. Why don't you know how shuffle works? it's supposed to shuffle my whole playlist, not just a bunch of songs you want me to hear on loop.

App has not stopped crashing since the last update. Now I can't even get songs to play for 2 seconds before the app completely crashes and I get a notification saying the app has a bug and to update when a fix is provided. I pay for premium and I can't access my playlists on mobile without the app crashing, which means I can't even access the playlists I've downloaded for offline listening. I've already cleared the cache, as instructed, but it made it worse. So frustrating.

I hate how Spotify gives you 4 ads. Like, I just thought it was 2 ads? And don't even get me started that you can't rewind on the free version, then they give you random songs that aren't on your playlist, which is stupid even SoundCloud, and YouTube Music is better. The only thing I like is that the music can play in the background if you're off the app.

The app keeps glitching out. After about 2-3 days it will randomly get stuck on a song, and play ONLY that song on repeat. Want to enjoy your Playlist? No, one song. Want to look up a specific song and then have it play similar music? Nope, just that song. The only fix I have found is to uninstall and reinstall, sometimes more than once. Update: it now cannot go more than a day without getting stuck on a song. Why am I paying for what is effectively a CD with one track?

Please urgently fix the shuffle. Many of us have tried everything so that a 30 hour long Playlist doesn't play the same 20 songs yet the app still does so. It is very annoying and frustrating wanting to play ALL of your songs and only hearing the same 5 to the point where you can't stand listening to them again. It ruins the experience of listening to music. Please change this. The app would be great if this wasn't such a big issue.

at this point, I might as well use yt music because a lot of the stuff that I feel like should be part of the free version isn't like, we only get six skips per hour.And I agree, we hardly even get like any options of our own playlist, like we make the playlist.We don't want other people barging in on our own playlist. i really hope that eventually it gets better.Because it's really frustrating right now sometimes.

reorganized a playlist and now it won't save. deleted playlists show up even if there's nothing in them. the only good thing is you can find almost any audio you can think of. Edit: they have made editing playlists worse and I absolutely reinstalled cause I thought not being able to put the song where you want it was a mess up, but nope, I can't even finish fixing that playlist now

I just super hate that everything is behind a paywall. you can only skip a certain amount in an hour, you can't drag to a spot in the song to see if it's what you're looking for, you cant create a Playlist of your own without it shuffling the songs and then including its own. Basically, you lose any customization if you don't pay. and for those reasons, I'm out.

Good: Has a lot of music on it and the automatic radio station stuff works pretty well. Meh: The UI has slowly, but consistently, gotten worse over time. It's still usable, but it's also getting buggier and buggier (something to do with how they're having AI write all their code? It does feel sloppy). Bad: Every time you open it, you get pop-ups asking you about stuff you'll never want. Close one and another appears immediately afterwards. In short: Plays music, but doesn't seemingly want to.

I just got a new device because my last one has been having issues. same brand, same style device, same Spotify account aswell. On my previous device I was able to skip without having to worry about ANY limits, and I could pick the song I wanted to listen to but now? six skips per hour, can't pick the song I want to listen to. I've been getting recommended songs that are not on my playlist and I can't fix it without installing the app. Just admit it's only about the money.

I really like spotify. I have found so many great songs and music. I also appreciate the podcasts and have used the books once. My only concern was when I downloaded some songs in a Playlist, it wouldn't play. I closed the app and restarted to no avail. Typically this not a problem though. As in any app there can be glitches.

Used to be an amazing music app. Best one I had. Then like most other companies, they got money hungry. They expect you to listen to FIVE ads in a row. Who in their right minds downloads a music app to listen to more ads than music. It's actually out of control. 2nd problem is when you have your OWN playlist specifically crafted to your taste, they want to throw in "suggested" songs that are not even the same genre and you only have six skips so it's too bad if you don't like it right Spotify?

constant skipping. I am so sick of feeling like a 90s kid running with a discman with how often music skips. its been an issue for a long time and they don't seem to care. update: tried to reinstall. still happens. now my issue is that homepage is so full of stuff I dont care about, I cant even find a way to find new music. I used to love the recommendations based on what I listened to, now Spotify is trying to do everything and none of it they are doing well. maybe YouTube music is better.

I honestly can't remember how long I've had this app. maybe like 7 years now? it seems like the last few years though the price has increased. I love my music but in this economy I can only pay so much for music before I bust out my iPod and radio. if prices keep increasing I'll have to cancel. also for the price, why did the small widget have to go? I don't want no huge widget on my screen, the thing literally takes half the screen. I might as well be in the app. also some songs just disappear.

Had to uninstall and reinstall to fix a blank screen. If I check the play queue on a free account, the app now straight up lies about what's ahead and never actually returns to the original album or playlist. Otherwise: I can easily add playlists and access all the recommendations associated with my account, and Premium's offline option works well to save data. And I can rearrange the order of songs within a playlist! Unfortunately, no folder arrangement support. No ICE ads, please.

Very good with premium, but terrible with the free version. Practically useless if you don't pay them every month. With premium, however, it is about the best music app available. The free version just contains a TON of advertisements and only allows you 6 skips an hour, whilst also recommending you songs, so if you get a random song you dislike, you can't skip it. The rating fluctuates depending on whether or not you have premium. I understand the 6 skips, but the recommended songs? Too far.

Spotify has become the soundtrack to my life. Whether I'm cooking, road tripping, cleaning, writing, or having a full-blown existential crisis in the shower, Spotify always seems to know exactly what song I need. The playlists are fantastic, discovering new music is effortless, and being able to switch from Thomas Bergersen to Falling in Reverse to 80s rock without judgment is a beautiful thing. Worth every penny.

I used to love this app but lately the bugs are so bad. I can't listen to music without it glitching. I can't add music to my favorites or any playlist without adding it a few times or it doesn't add it at all. I constantly have to force stop it. I pay for no ads and yet I still get ads when I play podcasts. I'm honestly thinking of taking my business elsewhere.

The music selection is great and that's pretty much it. I'm absolutely sick to death of podcasts and audiobooks. I just want music and Spotify has turned it's focus to other things, including garbage AI. The discover feed is pretty poor now, doesn't really find any more artists that you'd like that are similar but I see nothing but full screen ads for things I don't care about, and I pay you ad free Spotify. I'm definitely at the point where I will be looking at other apps that fit my needs bett

Always making improvements huh? Like REMOVING the icon next to tracks that lets me know that they are in a playlist!? I can't remember which of my liked songs are in a playlist when I'm going through them to see if I want to put the ones that aren't in a playlist into one of my playlists! So now I would have to look at every one of them individually to find out. I'm tired of paying for Premium only to keep haveing a worse experience. If that isn't fixed y'all will be losing A LOT of customers.

Spotify is great! You can find songs for any mood you are in and all of your favorite songs! I personally love it except for this 2 things. 1st is that skips are limited and you cant go back, and that you cant fast forward or rewind songs! The 2nd is that when I want to listen to all of my songs on 1 of my playlists, it has too little songs so it played songs that arent on the playlist! Im pretty sure that there is a way to turn that off and if so, could someone tell me? Overall Spotify is great

June 2026 update: how many times do I have to hide a "Mixed" compilation album track from my release radar before your algorithm realizes I only want full songs? Second, must of the "Mixed" tracks are from compilation albums and not real new releases, in most cases the songs have been out for years. as a DJ this makes my life so difficult. Spotify just keeps disappointing, I wish I could give it negative stars!

I've been using this app for almost 10 years and it's become unusable. it's been incredibly laggy recently and keeps crashing and giving me the prompt "This app has a bug please clear the cache." I did that and it keeps happening now prompting me with "this app has a bug please wait for developers to provide an update" it only effects the DJ and audio books frequently. like songs and other Playlist make it crash less frequently.

The ads are getting way too constant, like after every single song and even during one. But overall, the app is absolutely amazing and I can always find the music I want. There's almost really no limitations other than that, ESPECIALLY with the fact there's not really a limit to how many songs I have in a playlist 🫂 and I don't have premium. Again, ads are CONSTANT, and never ending. premium is so expensive for no reason and no actual improvement has been made

You essentially can't do a thing without premium. You can't even add a song to your queue without premium anymore, and it plays whatever it likes. Which is usually not accurate in the types of songs you listen to, despite saying so, leaving you to listen to random un-enjoyable songs cut up by ads, and maybe have a chance of getting a song you actually have on your playlist, and like, to play.

The app is good, but pretty much only with a ridiculously overpriced subscription. The free version is genuinely terrible, and one of the things that really annoys me is that you can't even control the order of your songs. I'll queue up a playlist, and it will add a bunch of random songs for no reason. And every time I try to play a song I actually enjoy, the app throws everything else out of order. Honestly might go back to yt music.

Been using Spotify for a decade or more. They somehow manage to make the UI worse with each update. Rather than fixing the problems, they just add more features nobody wants. I can't open my queue anymore, or add songs to it from playlists. I have to take multiple steps to add a song to a playlist, because Spotify apparently wants me to put every song in my "liked songs" like a psychopath. Listen to your users Spotify, you're only relevant as long as you're better than the alternatives.

We've gone from 5 stars, to 2 stars, to 1 star. Been a premium member for well over 10 years. The app constantly puts me offline no matter if I'm on wifi or 5G highspeeds. Deletes all my downloads. Randomly stops playing music and will just start playing something else. The queue doesn't work half the time. Auto generated playlists are random stuff I don't listen to, and my "on repeat" is sometimes stuff I don't listen to. It's too expensive for it to be so bad.

Too much visual clutter on the homepage. When I open the app, I just want to see my main playlists and easily scroll through my library. Instead I encounter pop-ups for music, podcasts, events, and announcements I don't really care for. An AI bar I don't want to use. Suggestions I don't want. Audiobooks when I never use that feature. Save all the extra stuff for the web version please or separate it into a "Recommendations" tab that uses the vital space the "Create" tab occupies. It's too much!

I'd pick Spotify over any other music app instantly, honestly. There are a lot of ads, though. It's very easy to navigate, and they have so many songs on there, that if you somehow can't find one on another app, it could possibly be on Spotify! I also listen to it during school, and it genuinely helps me get through the day. There are limited skips and it will choose recommended songs. However, I only listen to my liked songs, so I don't run into that problem.

I have the paid version which is such a huge improvement over the free. I like having access offline and one click to the music videos.
